My name is Huanran Sun, and I am from China. I graduated from Yanbian University with a bachelor’s degree, and I am currently pursuing a Master of Arts in Economics (MAE) at the University of Winnipeg.



I enjoy working out, fishing, and playing League of Legends. I have two cats named Dingding and Niuniu, as well as a Golden Retriever who is eight months old. This is what my life in Canada looks like right now.
